name: Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM)
short_description: A full marathon in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, held on October 4, 2026, starting at Dataran Merdeka, with registration open now.
ai_summary: The Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM) is a full-marathon event scheduled for October 4, 2026, starting at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Organized by Dirigo Events Sdn Bhd, it offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with entry priced at MYR 150.
pros: Multiple distance options (marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km) to suit different runner levels
Iconic starting venue at Dataran Merdeka in the heart of Kuala Lumpur
